title: DOCI Thread — Create Request
description: Request body for POST /api/thread.php. Creates a thread document anchored to a passage on its parent. The thread itself becomes a document with doc_type='thread' and parent_guid set.

parent_guid.description: GUID of the document the thread anchors to.

quote.description: The selected passage on the parent document. Optional — without a quote the thread is page-level rather than passage-level.

occurrence_index.description: 0-based index of which occurrence of `quote` to anchor to. Client counts DOM occurrences before the selection. Ignored when no quote is supplied.

message.description: First message of the thread; stored as the body of the thread document.

ai_reply.description: When true and AI_GATEWAY_URL is configured, the server queues an AI-drafted follow-up reply. The thread document is created immediately; the reply is appended async.

ai_model.description: Override the model id passed to the AI gateway. Default is gateway-specific.
